title.romaji: Kono Subarashii Sekai ni Bakuen wo!
title.english: KONOSUBA -An Explosion on This Wonderful World!
title.native: この素晴らしい世界に爆焔を！

synonyms: ขอให้ระเบิดตูมตามในโลกแฟนตาซี!
為美好的世界獻上爆焰！
Да благословит взрыв сей расчудесный мир!
description:
This feisty young wizard will stop at nothing to master the spell that saved her life: Explosion! Megumin, the “Greatest Genius of the Crimson Magic Clan,” has chosen to devote her studies to the powerful offensive magic used by her mysterious savior. Then one day, her little sister finds a black kitten in the woods. But this cat isn’t just a new furry friend—she’s the key to awakening a Dark God!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

node.description:
Megumin is an archmage and the self-proclaimed top genius of the Crimson Demons, an order of magicians who are born with high intelligence and magical powers.

Despite being an archwizard, she can only use the high level skill 'Explosion', the strongest of all offensive magic, and only once a day as it consumes tremendous magical power. Due to this she is more often a liability than an asset.

Megumin speaks and dresses as a Chuunibyou and her only desire is to unleash explosion magic in the face of her enemies.

__Height:__ 162 cm (5'4")

A hikikomori (shut-in), otaku and NEET, Kazuma arrives in the afterlife after a traffic accident and decides to go to another world to defeat the Demon King, taking [Aqua](https://anilist.co/character/89362) with him.

He has the weakest job of 'Adventurer', but has decent intelligence and extraordinarily high luck. This is demonstrated whenever he uses his 'steal' skill.

Aqua is a goddess of water. She guides humans who die young to the afterlife.

Due to her cocky attitude towards [Kazuma](https://anilist.co/character/89364), she ends up being dragged to another world with him to defeat the Demon King.

Aqua chose the advanced job of archpriest, as being a goddess she's naturally a strong wielder of healing magic. However, she spends most of her skillpoints on party trick skills.

A crusader and a masochist.

Despite being an advanced knight, she is extremely clumsy and none of her attacks ever hit their mark. However, she has great endurance and stamina and acts as the frontline of the party. She often throws herself in front of enemies to "shield" her party, but in reality it's just her masochism.
Yunyun is a member of the Crimson Magic Clan, and she and [Megumin](https://anilist.co/character/89361) are friends as well as rivals.

This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. 

Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

Wiz is the owner of a famous Magic Item Shop in Axel that has many unsalable items with quirky defects. She used to be a renowned Arch Wizard, but has since retired. At night, she has a secret identity as a kind-hearted lich who helps lingering spirits pass on. She is also the only harmless Demon King's General and prefers to live as a human.

alternative: Shikkoku no Majuu (しっこくの魔獣)

node.description:
Chomusuke acts as [Megumin](https://anilist.co/character/89361)'s familiar. She is a black cat with a red cross-shaped marking on her forehead and bat like wings. She cannot speak human language, but she seems to be fairly intelligent and can understand human speech to some extent.  

~!She is actually the other half of Lady Wolbach, who was sealed in the Crimson Demon Village.!~

Eris is the Goddess of Fortune and [Aqua's](https://anilist.co/character/89362) junior. Eris is a very kind and gentle girl who treats others with kindness and respect. She is also very caring and she always interest her adherents. She has a very cheerful attitude but at times can act a bit childish. She is insecure about her breast size and uses breast pads to compensate. Aqua often embarrasses her with this knowledge, as Eris wants as few people as possible to notice her lack in bust. She is also kind-hearted and gentle, and therefore, her scent is very fragrant, according to her peers and Aegis.

~!Eris disguises herself as Chris, a friend to [Darkness](https://anilist.co/character/89363) listed under the occupation of thief. Chris is an innocent, cheerful and energetic girl that is almost always seen with a big smile and boasting a bright personality. She also seems to have high confidence in herself. Though at times she acts quite childish and mischievous, Chris has a big, kind heart.!~
Komekko is [Megumin](https://anilist.co/character/89361)'s adorable younger sister. She is a young Crimson Demon and the only Crimson Magic kid around her age.

Part of the Guild Staff, she is the go-to woman for adventurers visiting the guild. Luna is a very kind, caring and cheerful young woman who has a rather ''Onee-chan'' (big sister) aura about her. She has common sense which is a rarity in the Fantasy World. Luna is also a calm person, taking everything in stride.
Royal Prosecutor for the Kingdom of Belzerg.

Arue is one of Megumin's old classmates and the third highest scoring student in her class, only trailing behind Megumin and Yunyun respectively. She's an aspiring author and, according to herself, the most voluptuous among the Crimson Demons.

An anime-exclusive character. The first person [Kazuma](https://anilist.co/character/89364) speaks with in Axel's guildhall.

(Source: Wikipedia)
Cecily is a priestess of the Axis Order. She has an attraction to young girls, which she doesn't try to hide at all.

Wolbach is a goddess that presides over violence and sloth. She serves as one of the eight generals of the Demon King and has many worshippers within the Demon King's army. 

~!She was a major antagonist, being one of the most predominately featured of the eight generals of the Demon King's army, and was the arch-nemesis of the adventurer Megumin.

Wolbach was split into two beings and sealed within a complex sealing stone; one of these beings represented the sloth aspect of Wolbach while the other one represented the aspect of violence and took the form of a huge black beast. Approximately 8 years prior to the main series, a young Megumin was playing with the complex sealing stone and accidentally released Wolbach and her other half, which went on a rampage. Wolbach used Explosion to defeat the beast and save Megumin, then she sapped her violence aspect of most of its energy before resealing it, deciding to come back for it when it was more calm. Wolbach then taught Megumin the spell "Explosion" as thanks and left the Crimson Demon Village behind. Despite being an "evil god" and a general of the Demon King, Wolbach was shown to be of relatively high moral standing. Although she was a Goddess, Wolbach didn't talk down to Megumin (who at the time was a young girl) and elicited concern about the young girl's future as she thought Megumin dedicating her life to Explosion would be a waste.

The aspect of violence was later unknowingly unsealed by Megumin's younger sister Komekko seven years later. Because violence was so weak after its confrontation with sloth, Komekko was able to best it and bring it home for lunch. However, Megumin, believing it was a common house cat in its weakened form, kept the aspect of violence as her pet/familiar and called it Chomusuke.!~
Yuiyui is the mother of [Megumin](https://anilist.co/character/89361) and [Komekko](https://anilist.co/character/120653).

Arnes is a greater devil who served and worshiped [Wolbach](https://anilist.co/character/177157), the Goddess of Sloth and Violence. ~!She was killed by [Megumin's](https://anilist.co/character/89361) explosion magic after she attempted multiple times to kidnap [Chomusuke](https://anilist.co/character/120654), the violent aspect of Wolbach.!~
She is a member of the Crimson Demons and Megumin's former classmate alongside Dodonko.
A Japanese citizen who was also reincarnated to the fantasy world by Aqua. He is one of Belzerg's strongest adventurers and wields the cursed sword Gram. The sword was his gift from Aqua.
She is a member of the Crimson Demons and Megumin's former classmate alongside Funifura.
Hyoizaburoo is [Megumin](https://anilist.co/character/89361)'s father and a magic item craftsman.
Soketto is a member of the Crimson Magic Clan and a fortune teller in the Crimson Magic Village.

alternative: Maken no Yuusha no Nakama (魔剣の勇者の仲間)

node.description: Zesta is the current leader of the Axis Order, who worship the goddess Aqua, and a powerful arch-priest. He also directly leads the chapter in Arcanletia, the home of the Axis Order.

Bukkororii is a member of the Crimson Demons. He is the son of a shoe-shop owner and as such is destined to become the Crimson Demons' greatest (and only) shoemaker. He is also Megumin's next-door neighbor.
Ryze's little sister.
Ain is an adventurer in the Kingdom of Belzerg.
Lott is an adventurer in the Kingdom of Belzerg.
